summary: Iteration 27 verified all 3 fixes: (1) marketing Footer renders on / /how-it-works /use-cases /pricing /case-studies /faq with Product+Connect columns visible above the fold at bottom, (2) generated PDF (via /api/projects/{id}/export.pdf) contains NO '§' (U+00A7) in extracted text (pypdf) while section headings 'SCOPE' remain, (3) both /api/share/{token}/accept and /reject/confirm now require client_email (EmailStr) — POST without it returns 422, invalid email returns 422, and valid email is persisted lowercased+trimmed to share_review.client_email. Frontend AcceptForm and RejectFlow (suggestions phase) both render a mandatory 'YOUR EMAIL (REQUIRED)' input with data-testid='review-signature-email'; submit button disabled while email empty; invalid regex triggers 'Enter a valid email' client-side error; valid email produces 200 accept/reject. E2E accept flow ended in review-done-state 'DOCUMENT ACCEPTED'; e2e reject flow ended in 'CONCERNS DELIVERED'. Backend suite: 8/8 pytest tests passed.

verified_features.detail: pypdf-extracted text from /api/projects/{demo}/export.pdf contains 0 occurrences of '\u00a7'. 'SCOPE' heading still present. My initial byte-level test caught 0xA7 inside FlateDecode compressed streams (false positives) — text-level extraction is the correct check.

data-testid='site-footer' rendered in viewport on /how-it-works, /use-cases, /pricing, /case-studies, /faq, and / (landing). Footer top ~511px on 900px viewport (fully visible). Screenshot confirms PRODUCT column (How it works / Use cases / Pricing / Case studies) and CONNECT column (Start a project / support@use-bracket.com / @use_bracket / LinkedIn) both render. z-index=10 lifts above marketing-ambient overlay.

AcceptForm shows label 'YOUR EMAIL (REQUIRED)' + input data-testid='review-signature-email'. Submit button disabled while email empty (verified via is_disabled()). Invalid email like 'not-an-email' surfaces client-side error 'Enter a valid email — we'll send you the signed PDF here.' via [data-testid=review-accept-error].

POST /api/share/{token}/accept body includes client_email; response 200. Playwright captured request+response. Backend test confirms share_review.client_email stored as 'test-accept@example.com' (lowercased+trimmed from '  TEST-Accept@Example.COM  ').

verified_features.feature: Reject flow — mandatory client_email UI on suggestions phase
verified_features.detail: After typing concerns and clicking 'See Bracket suggestions', suggestions phase renders same 'YOUR EMAIL (REQUIRED)' input. Submit ('Send concerns') disabled while empty. Invalid email surfaces 'Enter a valid email — we'll email you a copy of your concerns.' error.
POST /api/share/{token}/reject/confirm 200 with client_email in body. Backend test confirms lowercased+trimmed persistence.

AcceptIn/RejectConfirmIn pydantic models with EmailStr: missing client_email → 422 (field required); invalid email like 'not-an-email' → 422 with 'value is not a valid email address'. All four assertions passed.

critical_code_review_comments: PDF sanitization: server.py `_pdf_text()` should scrub § globally at output time (currently H() no longer prepends '\u00a7 ', but any § from user content flowing into the PDF wouldn't be caught). Consider adding '\u00a7': '' to the sanitization dict in _pdf_text for defense-in-depth.
ClientReview.jsx duplicates the email-regex + client-side error copy between AcceptForm and RejectFlow. Extract a helper `validateClientEmail(str)` to avoid divergence.

AcceptForm submit's disabled condition is `!allChecked || !name.trim() || !email.trim()` — only checks non-empty, not shape. That's fine because regex check runs on submit(); but the UX inconsistency (button enabled with an invalid string) could be tightened by also requiring the regex to pass before enabling.

Backend server.py: /accept & /reject/confirm both call `send_client_receipt_email` inside a try/except that logs `warning`. RESEND_API_KEY presence isn't checked before construction. Emailer is fire-and-forget per spec — verified endpoints return 200 even when email side-effect fails.
MarketingLayout renders Footer for the landing route too (isLanding true still hits the return path with Footer). Good — consistent site chrome.
